title: How 50 Otters Became A Climate Defense
hook: A nearly erased predator came back and began protecting kelp carbon.
closing: Saving sea otters can restore a food web and preserve coastal carbon.
question: Would you protect otter habitat?

segments.say: California sea otters fell to 50 by the 1930s. The fur trade nearly erased their role from the coast.
Those 50 became about 3,000 otters today. Their recovery returned a crucial kelp predator.
Otter-protected kelp could store 8.7 million metric tons of carbon dioxide yearly. Their comeback now helps defend the climate.
